notes.research_segment_rows: Rows with row_type=research_segment have no business to find. business_mentioned will be false by design and that is not a loss, it is the row doing its job. The payload is sources_cited plus competitors_mentioned: which sources the engine feeds on, and which brands it names, for a whole segment. Added 2026-08-04 to map short-term rentals, a vertical no AEO vendor has published a single dated check on.

_schema_note_domain: domain fields added 2026-08-06. WHY: rank-of-business cannot be measured by matching a business NAME against a result HOSTNAME. World Martial Arts Academy proved this: its site is blackbeltstl.com, so name matching scored it a confident zero while it actually ranked at organic position two. Any analysis MUST use the domain field, MUST honour domain_confidence, and MUST count a match on domain_alternates as a hit. A row with domain_confidence UNVERIFIED is reportable only with the row flagged. A row with domain null and confidence VERIFIED means the business genuinely has no website, which is a finding and not a gap.
